title: JimmyBot Writeup

steps.text: Story: Magnus college deployed a bot to help students study programming. Unfortunately, there’s a critical vulnerability in it. Find it before some bad actors use it for malicious activities.

Solution: Jimmy bot is an automated discord bot with a dash of AI and a fatal flaw.
 By giving help command, the bot will list the functionalities.

 By giving the command .ls we can see the flag.txt and a python script encode.py

 Using the .viewcode function, the bot displays some code blocks and the reverse function is the one with the vulnerability.
